name: sunday
description: Connects your AI to Sunday (sunday.work), NetConnect's work management system: tickets, projects, reports, leaves, overtime, evaluations. Sign in with your NetConnect account; you act as yourself with your own Sunday rights.

interface.longDescription: Find tickets, inspect projects and reports, and make requested updates in Sunday. Connect with NetConnect SSO; available tools and data follow your Sunday account's permissions.
defaultPrompt: Show my open Sunday tickets and blockers.
Find the status and recent updates of a Sunday ticket.
